AdminOverviewIntro: Pufferfin drives your catalogs, download services and seeding policy. Everything is configured here; environment variables only provide initial values.
AdminConfigLoadError: The Pufferfin configuration could not be loaded.
AdminGroupNotFound: This configuration page does not exist.
Group.catalogs.Description: Where Pufferfin finds movies, series, people and audiobooks that are not on disk yet.
Group.movies.Description: Radarr downloads the movies requested from Pufferfin.
Group.series.Description: Sonarr downloads the series and episodes requested from Pufferfin.
Group.downloads.Description: Prowlarr searches the indexers and qBittorrent downloads the releases.
Group.optional.Description: Services that add features when they are configured. Pufferfin works without them.
Group.language.Description: Which audio Pufferfin looks for. When no preferred language is available, the original version is used.
Group.behavior.Description: How many downloads run at once, how long downloads keep seeding, and where the files are stored.
ServiceStatus.DisabledHelp: Not configured. Fill in the fields below to enable it.
ServiceStatus.Label: Status of {0}: {1}
SecretReplacePlaceholder: Enter a new value to replace it
SecretWillBeCleared: Will be cleared when you save.
SecretWriteOnlyHelp: For security, the current value is never shown. Leave the field blank to keep it.
EnvironmentReadOnlyHelp: Set by the environment variable {0}. It is locked here so that the deployment stays in charge of it. To edit it from this page, remove the variable from the deployment and restart the server.
EnvironmentIgnoredHelp: The environment variable {0} is ignored: this value was changed here, and changes made here take precedence.
ValidationUrl: Enter an absolute http or https address, without credentials, query string or fragment.
ValidationMinimum: Enter a value of at least {0}.
ValidationMaximum: Enter a value of at most {0}.
ValidationPath: Enter an absolute folder path such as /media, without '..'.
ValidationLanguageList: Enter language codes such as fr or pt-BR, separated by commas.
ValidationTextList: Enter short identifiers made of letters, digits, - or _, separated by commas.
ValidationSeedMaxDays: Must be greater than or equal to the minimum seeding time.
SettingsNoChanges: There are no changes to save.
SettingsInvalid: Some values are invalid. Check the highlighted fields.
SettingsSaveError: The settings could not be saved. Try again.
AutoConfigHelp: Pufferfin replays its automatic configuration of the services at startup and after every save. It only creates what is missing and never changes a setting made by hand in Radarr, Sonarr or qBittorrent.
AutoConfigNoSteps: No configuration step is registered yet.
AutoConfigLoadError: The result of the last run could not be loaded.
AutoConfigRunError: The automatic configuration could not be run.
SeedPolicyLastCycle: Last run of the hourly task: {0}
SeedPolicyNeverRun: The hourly task has not run yet.
SeedCycle.Completed: Policy run: {0} torrents removed, {1} kept until their minimum seeding time, {2} kept until their import is confirmed.
SeedCycle.Skipped: Nothing to do: qBittorrent is not configured.
SeedCycle.Failed: qBittorrent could not be reached. Nothing was removed; the next run comes sooner.
SeedCycleRunError: The seeding policy could not be run.
StorageIntro: The real disk usage, how much of it seeding takes, and what happens to each download.
StorageLoadError: The storage report could not be loaded.
StorageDiskUnavailable: This folder does not exist on the server, or its disk cannot be read.
StorageAdvice.HardlinksImpossible: The library and the downloads are on different disks or mounts: downloads cannot be hard linked into the library, so seeding takes their space twice.
StorageAdvice.HardlinksUnknown: Pufferfin could not check whether downloads can be hard linked into the library.
StorageAdvice.DiskAlmostFull: A disk reached the usage warning threshold.
StorageAdvice.DirectoryMissing: A configured folder does not exist on the server. Check the library and downloads folders on the Behavior page.
StorageAdvice.QBittorrentUnavailable: qBittorrent could not be reached: the seeding state of the downloads is missing.
StorageHardlinks.Possible: Hard links work: seeding takes no extra space.
StorageHardlinks.Impossible: Hard links are impossible between the downloads and the library.
StorageHardlinks.Unknown: Hard links have not been checked.
StorageContentSharedHelp: Hard linked into the library: seeding it takes no extra space.
StorageContentSeedingOnlyHelp: Only seeding holds it: what removing the torrents would free.
StorageContentUnknownHelp: Files that could not be read.
StorageContentNoHardlinks: Because hard links are impossible, the space taken by seeding comes on top of the library.
StorageTorrentsHelp: Every torrent the seeding policy manages. A torrent whose title was deleted keeps seeding until its minimum seeding time: it is waiting for release.
PurgeReason.Released: released after its minimum seeding time
StorageLibraryHelp: Delete a title from the library. The safe mode is the default: private torrents keep seeding until their minimum seeding time.
StorageLibraryLoadError: The library titles could not be loaded.
DeleteMode.Safe.Help: The library files are deleted now. A private torrent keeps seeding until its minimum seeding time, then the hourly task removes it.
DeleteMode.Immediate.Help: Everything is deleted now, private torrents included, even before their minimum seeding time.
DeletePlanLoading: Loading what the deletion would do
DeletePlanNoTorrent: No download of this title is seeding.
TorrentAction.KeepUntilMinimumUnknown: Keeps seeding until its minimum seeding time, then removed
TorrentAction.KeepShared: Kept: another title of the library still uses it
DeleteImmediateWarning: {0} private torrents have not seeded their minimum yet. Removing them now can get the tracker account banned for hit and run.
DeleteImmediateWarningNone: Every torrent of this title is public or past its minimum seeding time.
DeleteImmediateConfirm: I understand that private torrents are removed before their minimum seeding time.
DeletionError.NotFound: This title is no longer in the library, or not in a library you can see.
DeletionError.Forbidden: You are not allowed to delete this title with this mode.
DeletionError.ServiceDisabled: Radarr or Sonarr, which holds this title, is not configured. Nothing was deleted.
DeletionError.ServiceUnavailable: A service could not be reached, or the files could not be deleted. Nothing was deleted.
DeletionError.ConfirmationRequired: The immediate mode needs your confirmation. Nothing was deleted.
DeletionError.Planned: The deletion could not be completed.
DeletionError.Deleted: The deletion could not be completed.
DeletionError.Unknown: The deletion could not be completed.
DeletionDoneWaiting: {0} was deleted. {1} torrents keep seeding until their minimum seeding time.
RequestsIntro: Every request of every user, in queue order. Requests waiting for approval or for a download slot can be moved up or down.
RequestsLoadError: The requests could not be loaded.
RequestActionError: This change could not be applied. The request may have changed meanwhile.
RequestProblem.ServiceDisabled: Radarr or Sonarr is not configured.
RequestProblem.ServiceUnavailable: Radarr or Sonarr could not be reached or refused the call.
RequestProblem.TitleUnknown: TMDB, Radarr or Sonarr does not know this title.
RequestProblem.TvdbIdMissing: TMDB gives no TVDB id for this series, and Sonarr needs one.
RequestProblem.NoRootFolder: Radarr or Sonarr has no root folder to file the title in.
RequestProblem.EpisodeNotFound: Sonarr has no episode matching this number or air date.
RequestProblem.NoRelease: No release found yet. The search runs again later.
RequestProblem.IndexersUnavailable: The indexers could not be reached. The search runs again later.
RequestProblem.NoIndexer: Radarr or Sonarr has no indexer able to search.
RequestProblem.OnlySeasonPacks: Only season packs were found, and a season pack is never taken for one episode.
RequestProblem.NoAcceptableLanguage: Releases exist, but none in a preferred language nor in the original version.
RequestProblem.ImportBlocked: Radarr or Sonarr cannot import the download.
RequestProblem.DownloadWarning: The download client reports a warning. The download goes on.
UsersIntro: Who may request titles, with or without approval, with which weekly quota, and who may delete titles. Administrators always have every right.
UsersLoadError: The users could not be loaded.
PermissionsLoadError: The rights of this user could not be loaded.
PermissionAdministrator: Administrator: every right, without approval nor quota.
PermissionRequiresApproval: Requests need the approval of an administrator
PermissionCanDelete: May delete titles, with the safe mode
PermissionRequiresApprovalLabel: Each request needs the approval of an administrator
PermissionWeeklyQuotaHelp: Number of requests allowed in seven days. Leave empty for no limit.
PermissionCanDeleteHelp: With the safe mode only: private torrents keep seeding until their minimum seeding time. The immediate mode is reserved to administrators.
PermissionsSaveError: The rights could not be saved.
ValidationQuota: Enter a whole number of 0 or more, or leave the field empty for no limit.
Setting.RADARR_URL.Help: Address of Radarr, for example http://radarr:7878.
Setting.SONARR_URL.Help: Address of Sonarr, for example http://sonarr:8989.
Setting.PROWLARR_URL.Help: Address of Prowlarr, for example http://prowlarr:9696.
Setting.QBITTORRENT_URL.Help: Address of the qBittorrent Web UI, for example http://qbittorrent:8080.
Setting.QBITTORRENT_USERNAME.Help: User name of the qBittorrent Web UI.
Setting.QBITTORRENT_PASSWORD.Help: Password of the qBittorrent Web UI.
Setting.BAZARR_URL.Help: Address of Bazarr, for example http://bazarr:6767.
Setting.SHELFMARK_URL.Help: Address of Shelfmark, used to download audiobooks.
Setting.TMDB_API_KEY.Help: An API key or a read access token, from the API section of your TMDB account settings.
Setting.TMDB_LANGUAGES.Help: Languages of the titles, summaries and search results from TMDB, in order of preference, separated by commas, for example fr-FR, en-US. When empty, en-US is used.
Setting.FLARESOLVERR_URL.Help: Address of FlareSolverr, for example http://flaresolverr:8191. Used by indexers protected by Cloudflare.
Setting.PREFERRED_AUDIO_LANGUAGES.Help: Language codes in order of preference, separated by commas, for example fr, en.
Setting.AUDIBLE_MARKETS.Help: Audible marketplaces searched for audiobooks, separated by commas, for example fr, us.
Setting.REJECT_SUBTITLED_ONLY: Reject releases that are only subtitled
Setting.REJECT_SUBTITLED_ONLY.Help: When the audio is wanted in a preferred language, refuse a release that only has subtitles in that language.
Setting.SEED_MIN_DAYS.Help: A download keeps seeding for at least this many days.
Setting.SEED_MAX_DAYS.Help: A download stops seeding after this many days.
Setting.SEED_TARGET_RATIO.Help: Once the minimum seeding time is reached, a download that reaches this ratio may be removed.
Setting.MAX_CONCURRENT_DOWNLOADS.Help: Number of downloads that can run at the same time.
Setting.SEED_CATEGORIES.Help: The seeding policy only removes torrents in these categories, separated by commas, for example radarr, sonarr. Torrents in other categories are never touched.
Setting.MEDIA_PATH.Help: Absolute path of the library, as the Pufferfin server sees it, for example /media. Used by the storage screen.
Setting.DOWNLOADS_PATH.Help: Absolute path of the downloads, as the Pufferfin server sees it, for example /downloads. On the same disk as the library, downloads can be hard linked and seeding takes no extra space.
Setting.QBITTORRENT_DOWNLOADS_PATH.Help: Absolute path of the downloads, as qBittorrent sees it. Only needed when it differs from the downloads folder of the Pufferfin server.
Setting.STORAGE_WARNING_PERCENT.Help: The storage screen warns when a disk is used at this percentage or more, from 1 to 100.
